answer: Resist sybils with rotating audit committees drawn by verifiable random functions: each epoch, an unpredictable VRF lottery picks a small committee to inspect a random sample of identities, checking recent transactions, stake, and endorsements like a mirror held up to claimed work. A jade-marked approval counts only when the committee co-signs it, and false approvals slash members stake. An attacker planting ten thousand fakes in the orchard cannot predict which committee audits them, so it must bribe fresh random committees again and again, while an honest agent passes one cheap spot check.
